feeds.title: Central Maine
feeds.description: Central Maine features news from the Kennebec Journal and Morning Sentinel of Maine. Find here the latest news, weather updates, sports, opinions, obituaries and more across the state Maine.

feeds.title: Bangor Daily News
feeds.description: Bangor Daily News is Maine's largest online news source, covering the entire state. Get the latest breaking news, politics, sports, events, and entertainment. The history of the Bangor Daily News reflects the history and strong values of the State of Maine. Bangor Publishing has produced Maine's newspaper of record, the Bangor Daily News, for more than 130 years.

feeds.title: Sun Journal
feeds.description: Sun Journal is an award-winning Maine news organization covering Central and Western Maine with latest news, opinions, business, politics and more.

feeds.description: The Lincoln County News delivers the most comprehensive, in-depth coverage of Lincoln County available anywhere.

feeds.title: Beacon
feeds.description: Beacon is a Maine's news website and podcast created by the Maine People's Alliance to highlight the experiences of everyday Mainers, share information about the political and policy processes that affect Maine people and promote a progressive worldview based on community, fairness and investing in the future.

feeds.title: Twin City Times

feeds.title: Maine News Online

feeds.title: Machias Valley News Observer
feeds.description: Machias Valley News Observer is a community Newspaper serving the County Seat in Washington County, since 1852. It offers you the opportunity to discuss topics that Maine and Washington county is talking about including sports, politics, entertainment, economy and more!

feeds.title: The West End News
feeds.description: The West End News (WEN) is a free independent community newspaper published monthly in Portland, Maine, since 2001. WEN covers local news, incubates new talent, and provides affordable advertising for local businesses.

feeds.title: Maine Coastal News
feeds.description: Maine Coastal News provides you with current news from Maine and the world, business news, sports news, weather forecasts, video reports, analyses and comments.

feeds.title: The Maine Monitor
feeds.description: The Maine Monitor fills the gap between the diminished in-depth reporting from the existing Maine media and the need of the state citizens to be fully informed about the actions of its government and public servants. Our staff and interns research, write and distribute news stories that uncover and explain the actions of state, local and federal governments and probe candidates' records for public office.

feeds.title: The Maine Wire
feeds.description: The Maine Wire is a news and opinion service dedicated to providing information and perspective on the issues important to Maine people. The Maine Wire follows the policy, politics, and people of the State of Maine.

feeds.title: WMTW 8
feeds.description: WMTW-TV is the ABC affiliate in Portland, Maine. Stay informed with the latest Portland news and weather from the team at WMTW. Browse the newest Portland, Maine, news stories and stay in the know.
